scope: Computational audio footprint analysis for original instrumental score generation; no listening or audio reuse.
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

analysis_settings.decode: ffmpeg -v error -i SOURCE -map 0:a:0 -ac 2 -ar 22050 -f f32le -; decoded to memory, never written as audio
analysis_settings.analysis_span: Trim decoded audio tail to native picture duration (frame_count / nominal frame_rate). Rene spectral/tempo summary is uncut source; events additionally map to output time.
analysis_settings.hpss: 31-bin/31-time-frame median estimates; harmonic energy proxy only
analysis_settings.transient_selection: Positive mean log-magnitude difference; local peaks >=80ms apart; top14 prominence peaks with >=650ms separation

originality_requirement: Generate new instrumental composition; do not reproduce source melody, harmony sequence, audio samples or voice.
steps: Probed each original source audio stream with ffprobe.
Decoded original audio to in-memory stereo float32 at22050Hz, trimmed audio tail to native picture duration and analyzed a mono mix.
Measured whole-mix energy, spectrum, stereo correlation and onset timing.
Estimated candidate periodicities from broadband and low-band onset autocorrelation; retained ambiguities.
Mapped Rene event times across the explicitly omitted source interval.
Prepared original-score briefs separately from measured facts; no original audio sampling, model generation or paid request.
content_model_evidence_note: All six actual saved model result texts inspected. Attributable endpoint/request IDs and raw-result hashes are in music-model-notes.json. Model interpretations remain separate from immutable signal measurements; this agent made no model/paid call or human listening pass.
